title: Budget Category Overrun Alert
dataSources: Micro-spend transactions (`microspend:txn`), no-spend days (`nospend:day`), price-per-use items (`priceperuse:item`), cash-back rewards (`cashback:reward`).
app: Bank-transaction exports categorised for micro-spending, no-spend-day trackers, price-per-use logs, and cash-back / rewards feeds — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=microspend:txn
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(amount) as spend by category _time
| eval budget=case(category="groceries",400,category="eating_out",150,category="coffee_snacks",60,1=1,200)
| eval over=if(spend>budget,1,0), over_by=round(spend-budget,2)
| where over=1
description: Alerts when spending in any category blows past its monthly budget, before the month-end surprise.
value: Catching an overrun mid-month leaves time to rein it in, unlike discovering it on the statement.
implementation: Set per-category budgets in `index=personal`; alert when a category exceeds its budget.
visualization: Table of over-budget categories with the overshoot.
grandmaExplanation: It warns when you have overspent in any budget area, so there is no nasty surprise at month end.
